title: SendGrid key in a Bearer header: one-property twin (length)
summary: 1 input is identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 42 vs contracted 43. Twin of "SendGrid key in a Bearer header: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of base62-bearer: length: 42 vs contracted 43. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
